verdict.rationale: WorkOS is an identity/authentication platform, not an AI agent or assistant that consumes tools; the evidence shows the reverse relationship — WorkOS exposes its own MCP server so that AI agents can call WorkOS's API (workos-docs-8, workos-docs-9, workos-docs-15, workos-probe-4), not that WorkOS itself plugs into and uses other MCP servers' tools. This 'client' axis is a category mismatch for an infrastructure/API product like WorkOS.
